Kaam karne wali gine jaana aur paisa milna ek baat nahi hai. July-September 2025 mein employed rural auraton mein se sirf 10.8% ke paas regular wage ya salaried job thi. 37.5% apna khud ka kaam karti thi ya employer thi, aur 34.2% household enterprises mein helpers thi [[es-2025-26-employment-chapter]], yaani survey ki bhasha mein family ke khet ya business mein bina tankhwah kaam karne wali family workers.

Matlab ek aurat din bhar khet mein kaam kar sakti hai aur phir bhi uske paas ek rupaya bhi apna nahi hota. Jab shaadi chhodne ka matlab ho na rehne ki jagah, na guzaare ka paisa, toh jiske haath mein paisa hai, bahar nikalne ka darwaza bhi usi ke haath mein hai.

## Shaadi ke baad ki demands: phir bhi dowry, phir bhi crime

Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 dowry ki definition deta hai: shaadi ke silsile mein di gayi ya dene ka vaada ki gayi koi bhi property ya valuable security, shaadi se pehle, shaadi par, ya shaadi ke baad kabhi bhi [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]]. Pehli Diwali par maangi gayi car, "bachchon ke liye" flat, ya pati ka business bachane ke liye paisa, yeh sab dowry ho sakta hai agar yeh shaadi se juda ho.

Dowry maangna, seedhe ya ghuma-phiraakar, chhe mahine se do saal tak ki jail aur Rs 10,000 tak ke fine wala crime hai. Dowry dena ya lena kam se kam paanch saal ki jail aur kam se kam Rs 15,000 ya dowry ki value, jo bhi zyada ho, ke fine wala crime hai. Yeh offences non-bailable hain [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]].

2024 mein police ne is Act ke under 12,343 cases register kiye, zyada tar Uttar Pradesh, Bihar aur Karnataka mein; West Bengal mein ek bhi nahi aur Maharashtra mein sirf 12 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh police ke kaam karne ka tareeka dikhata hai, dowry ka na hona nahi.

## Section 86, Domestic Violence Act, aur kaunsa law kab lagta hai

Jab demands ke saath harassment bhi ho, toh criminal law aata hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ka Section 85 us pati ya uske relative ko teen saal tak ki jail aur fine ki saza deta hai jo kisi aurat ke saath cruelty kare, aur Section 86 cruelty mein woh harassment bhi ginta hai jo use ya uski family ko property ki kisi illegal demand ko poora karne par majboor karne ke liye ho [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2024 mein police ne is cruelty ke, jo pehle IPC ka Section 498A tha, 1,20,227 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Domestic Violence Act alag tarah kaam karta hai. Yeh mainly civil law hai: magistrate abuse rukwa sakta hai, aurat ko shared ghar mein rehne ka order de sakta hai aur abuser se paise dilwa sakta hai, aur protection order use joint bank accounts chalane ya uske stridhan ko chhoone se rok sakta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Iske under police case sirf order todne par ya Protection Officer ke apni duty na nibhane par ho sakta hai, isliye 2024 mein police ne iske under sirf 616 criminal cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

| Situation | Kaunsa law lagta hai |
|---|---|
| Uske maa-baap se paise, car ya flat ki demand, shaadi ke baad bhi | Dowry Prohibition Act: dowry maangna |
| Demand poori na hone par use harass kiya jaata hai ya chot pahunchayi jaati hai | BNS Section 85 aur 86: cruelty |
| Uski salary, card, gehne ya stridhan le liye jaate hain, ya use bina paise ke rakha jaata hai | Domestic Violence Act: protection order aur monetary relief |
| Use sasural chhodne ko kaha jaata hai | Domestic Violence Act: residence order |
| Shaadi ke saat saal ke andar abnormal haalaat mein uski maut, jabki maut se kuch hi pehle dowry ko lekar cruelty hui ho | BNS Section 80: dowry death |

Yeh raaste ek saath chal sakte hain, aur Domestic Violence Act ki application ke liye pehle police case zaroori nahi hai.

## Apne paise ki hifazat: pehle kadam

Economic control dheere-dheere kasta hai, isliye pehle kadam chhote aur private hote hain:

- Ek bank account sirf apne naam par rakhiye, alerts ke liye apne phone number aur email ke saath.
- Aadhaar, PAN, bank passbook, degree certificates aur shaadi ke kaagzon ki copies ghar ke bahar rakhiye, kisi bharosemand insaan ke paas ya kisi secure online folder mein.
- Apne gehno aur stridhan ki photos lijiye, aur har demand ka proof dates ke saath save kijiye.
- Sasural ke bahar kisi ek insaan ko bataiye ki kya ho raha hai.

Women Helpline aur district ka One Stop Centre aapko counselling, legal aid aur shelter se jod sakte hain [[wcd-mission-shakti]], aur District Legal Services Authority free legal aid deti hai [[nalsa]]. Maa-baap sabse zyada madad yeh karke kar sakte hain ki har demand aur payment ka record rakhein, aur beti ko saaf-saaf bata dein ki woh ghar laut sakti hai.

forced-marriage-adult-legal-options.en:
Imagine a 24-year-old in Bhopal who comes home from work to find a wedding date fixed with a man she has met once. Her phone is taken "for a few days". Her brother says the cards are printed. Police data barely see this. NCRB's trafficking tables record 98 people rescued in 2024 who had been trafficked for forced marriage, out of 5,839 trafficking victims rescued [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. A daughter or son pushed into a wedding at home rarely reaches any table. This is general information, not legal advice.

## Arranged or forced: where is the line?

The line is consent, and it belongs to the two people marrying, not to their families. Parents can suggest, introduce and argue. A marriage becomes forced when "no" stops being an option: threats, beatings, being locked in, losing your phone, ID or salary, or being moved to another town for the wedding.

Force does not become lawful because a parent uses it. Beating an adult is a crime in itself: voluntarily causing hurt is punishable under Section 115(2) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, whoever does it [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Being locked in or threatened can be reported to the police too. If a wedding has already taken place without your free consent, ask a legal aid lawyer quickly whether a court can set it aside; time limits can apply.

Sons are forced too, and so are queer and trans adults whose families treat a wedding as a "cure". Being queer is not an illness. In June 2021 the Madras High Court directed that any attempt to medically "cure" or change the sexual orientation or gender identity of LGBTQIA+ people be prohibited, with action against the professionals involved [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]].

## What did the Supreme Court say in 2018?

In *Shakti Vahini v. Union of India* (2018), the Supreme Court held that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty, and ordered preventive, remedial and punitive measures to protect couples from "honour" crimes [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. If the choice of a partner is yours, so is the choice to refuse one: if your "yes" is yours to give, so is your "no".

In October 2024 the court added that marriages fixed while a child is still a minor violate their rights to "free choice, autonomy, agency and childhood" [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

The 2018 directions included special cells, fast-track courts and district monitoring committees. In December 2025, more than seven years later, the Delhi High Court was told that Delhi still had no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]]. The right is settled; the machinery is patchy.

## What if one of us is under 18 or 21?

Then it is a child marriage. Under the Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006, a woman under 18 or a man under 21 is a child, and a marriage in which either is a child is a child marriage [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. In October 2024 the Supreme Court noted that a 2021 Bill to raise women's minimum age to 21 was pending before Parliament [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]], but the Act sets 18. So a 19-year-old groom is legally a child; a 19-year-old bride is not.

A child marriage can be stopped in advance. In October 2024 the Supreme Court told magistrates to issue injunctions on their own to stop such weddings, especially around "auspicious days" for mass weddings [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Call the Child Helpline 1098, which is linked to the 112 emergency system [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Anyone who performs or abets a child marriage, and any adult man who marries a child, faces up to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment and a fine of up to Rs 1 lakh [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. If the wedding has happened, it is not automatically void: the person who was a child can ask a district court to annul it within two years of reaching adulthood [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Marriage never lowers the age of consent: sex with a wife under 18 is rape [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

## Who can I call, and where can I go?

If you are being confined, threatened or taken somewhere, call 112 [[mha-erss]]. Women can also call the Women Helpline [[wcd-mission-shakti]] or walk into a One Stop Centre (Sakhi). In July 2026, 985 of the 1,033 approved centres were operating, and they had assisted over 15.20 lakh women since April 2015 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. A centre is meant to connect you to police, medical, legal and counselling help in one place; ask there about a safe place to stay.

Section 173 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita lets you file a "Zero FIR" at any police station, irrespective of where the offence took place, or an e-FIR that you sign within 3 days, and you must get a free copy [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Men forced into marriage can use 112 and a Zero FIR in the same way.

Ask the centre or a legal aid lawyer whether the 2005 Domestic Violence Act covers your situation at home. It is mainly a civil law: a magistrate can pass a protection order, and breaking one is punishable with up to 1 year in prison or a Rs 20,000 fine [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. For a free lawyer, contact the National Legal Services Authority or your district legal services authority [[nalsa]].

## How do I leave home safely?

Plan before you move. Tell one trusted person outside the household, and agree on a code word. Keep your Aadhaar, certificates, bank details and phone within reach, with photos of the documents saved where your family cannot open them. Put some money aside. Know where the nearest police station and One Stop Centre are.

Leave when things are calm, and go straight to a safe place: a centre, a police station or a trusted friend. You are an adult, and where you live is your decision. If your family reports you missing, or accuses a friend or partner of kidnapping you, go to the police yourself and say that you are an adult who left by choice.

Take threats seriously. Police recorded only 36 murders with "honour killing" as the motive in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That count is hard to trust: NCRB recorded no honour killings in Tamil Nadu from 2020 to 2023 and one in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], yet in June 2026 the Madras High Court observed that the state had seen 59 over the past 10 years [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. If anyone threatens you after you leave, report it in writing and keep the copy.
forced-marriage-adult-legal-options.hg:
Sochiye, Bhopal mein 24 saal ki ek ladki office se ghar aati hai aur pata chalta hai ki uski shaadi ki date ek aise aadmi ke saath fix ho gayi hai jisse woh sirf ek baar mili hai. Uska phone "kuch dinon ke liye" le liya jaata hai. Bhai kehta hai ki card chhap chuke hain. Police data mein yeh sab mushkil se dikhta hai. NCRB ki trafficking tables ke mutabik 2024 mein 98 log rescue kiye gaye jinhe forced marriage ke liye traffic kiya gaya tha, us saal rescue hue kul 5,839 trafficking victims mein se [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Jo beti ya beta apne hi ghar mein shaadi ki taraf dhakela jaata hai, woh shayad hi kisi table tak pahunchta hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Arranged ya forced: line kahan hai?

Line consent ki hai, aur yeh consent shaadi karne wale do logon ki hoti hai, unki families ki nahi. Maa-baap rishta suggest kar sakte hain, milwa sakte hain, behas bhi kar sakte hain. Shaadi forced tab banti hai jab "na" kehna option hi na bache: dhamkiyan, maar-peet, ghar mein band kar dena, phone, ID ya salary chheen lena, ya shaadi ke liye kisi doosre shehar le jaana.

Zabardasti isliye legal nahi ho jaati ki use maa-baap kar rahe hain. Kisi adult ko maarna apne aap mein crime hai: voluntarily causing hurt Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ke Section 115(2) ke under punishable hai, chahe koi bhi kare [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Ghar mein band karke rakhne ya dhamkane ki report bhi police mein ki ja sakti hai. Agar shaadi aapki apni marzi ke bina ho chuki hai, toh jaldi kisi legal aid lawyer se poochiye ki kya court use radd kar sakti hai; iske liye time limits ho sakti hain.

Bete bhi force kiye jaate hain, aur woh queer aur trans adults bhi jinki families shaadi ko "ilaaj" samajhti hain. Queer hona koi bimari nahi hai. June 2021 mein Madras High Court ne direction diya ki LGBTQIA+ logon ki sexual orientation ya gender identity ko medically "cure" karne ya badalne ki har koshish par rok lagni chahiye, aur aisa karne wale professionals par action hona chahiye [[livelaw-madras-hc-sushma-2021]].

## 2018 mein Supreme Court ne kya kaha?

*Shakti Vahini v. Union of India* (2018) mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur couples ko "honour" crimes se bachane ke liye preventive, remedial aur punitive measures ka order diya [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Agar partner chunna aapka haq hai, toh kisi ko mana karna bhi aapka haq hai: agar aapki "haan" aapki apni hai, toh aapki "na" bhi aapki apni hai.

October 2024 mein court ne aage kaha ki jo shaadiyan bachche ke minor rehte hi fix kar di jaati hain, woh uske "free choice, autonomy, agency and childhood" ke rights ko todti hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

2018 ki directions mein special cells, fast-track courts aur district monitoring committees shaamil the. December 2025 mein, saat saal se zyada baad, Delhi High Court ko bataya gaya ki Delhi mein honour killing cases ke liye ab tak koi fast-track court nahi bana tha [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]]. Haq tay ho chuka hai; use lagu karne wali machinery adhoori hai.

## Agar hum mein se koi 18 ya 21 se kam ho toh?

Tab yeh child marriage hai. Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006 ke hisaab se 18 se kam umar ki ladki ya 21 se kam umar ka ladka "child" hai, aur jis shaadi mein dono mein se koi bhi child ho, woh child marriage hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne note kiya ki auraton ki minimum age 21 karne wala 2021 ka Bill Parliament mein pending tha [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]], lekin Act mein ladki ke liye 18 hi likha hai. Yaani 19 saal ka dulha legally child hai; 19 saal ki dulhan nahi.

Child marriage ko pehle se roka ja sakta hai. October 2024 mein Supreme Court ne magistrates se kaha ki aisi shaadiyan rokne ke liye woh khud injunction jaari karein, khaas kar un "auspicious days" ke aas-paas jab mass weddings hoti hain [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]]. Child Helpline 1098 par call kijiye, jo 112 emergency system se judi hai [[mwcd-child-helpline-sop-2023]].

Jo bhi child marriage karwata hai ya usme saath deta hai, aur jo adult aadmi kisi child se shaadi karta hai, use 2 saal tak ki rigorous imprisonment aur Rs 1 lakh tak ka fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Agar shaadi ho chuki hai, toh woh apne aap void nahi hoti: jo insaan shaadi ke waqt child tha, woh adult hone ke do saal ke andar district court se shaadi annul karwa sakta hai [[indiacode-pcma-2006]]. Shaadi se age of consent kam nahi hoti: 18 se kam umar ki patni ke saath sex rape hai [[sc-seva-child-marriage-2024]].

## Main kise call karun, aur kahan jaun?

Agar aapko band karke rakha ja raha hai, dhamkaya ja raha hai ya kahin le jaya ja raha hai, toh 112 call kijiye [[mha-erss]]. Auratein Women Helpline [[wcd-mission-shakti]] par bhi call kar sakti hain, ya seedhe One Stop Centre (Sakhi) ja sakti hain. July 2026 mein 1,033 approved centres mein se 985 chal rahe the, aur April 2015 se tab tak 15.20 lakh se zyada auraton ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Centre ka kaam aapko ek hi jagah police, medical, legal aur counselling help se jodna hai; wahan rehne ki safe jagah ke baare mein bhi poochiye.

Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita ka Section 173 aapko kisi bhi police station mein "Zero FIR" file karne deta hai, chahe offence kahin bhi hua ho. Aap e-FIR bhi kar sakte hain, jise 3 din ke andar sign karna hota hai, aur aapko FIR ki copy free milni chahiye [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Jin aadmiyon par zabardasti shaadi thopi ja rahi hai, woh bhi 112 aur Zero FIR ka isi tarah use kar sakte hain.

Centre ya legal aid lawyer se poochiye ki kya 2005 ka Domestic Violence Act aapke ghar ki situation par lagu hota hai. Yeh mainly ek civil law hai: magistrate protection order de sakta hai, aur use todne par 1 saal tak ki jail ya Rs 20,000 tak ka fine ho sakta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Free lawyer ke liye National Legal Services Authority ya apni district legal services authority se sampark kijiye [[nalsa]].

## Ghar se safely kaise niklun?

Kadam uthane se pehle plan banaiye. Ghar ke bahar ke kisi ek bharosemand insaan ko bataiye, aur ek code word tay kar lijiye. Apna Aadhaar, certificates, bank details aur phone paas rakhiye, aur documents ki photos aisi jagah save kijiye jahan aapki family na khol sake. Thode paise alag rakhiye. Pata rakhiye ki sabse paas ka police station aur One Stop Centre kahan hai.

Tab nikliye jab maahaul shaant ho, aur seedhe kisi safe jagah jaiye: centre, police station ya kisi bharosemand dost ke paas. Aap adult hain, aur aap kahan rahenge yeh aapka apna faisla hai. Agar family aapki missing report likhwati hai, ya kisi dost ya partner par aapko kidnap karne ka ilzaam lagati hai, toh khud police ke paas jaiye aur bataiye ki aap adult hain aur apni marzi se ghar chhoda hai.

Dhamkiyon ko halke mein mat lijiye. 2024 mein police ne poore desh mein sirf 36 murders ka motive "honour killing" record kiya [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Is number par bharosa karna mushkil hai: NCRB ne Tamil Nadu mein 2020 se 2023 tak ek bhi honour killing record nahi ki aur 2024 mein sirf ek [[ncrb-cii-2024]], jabki June 2026 mein Madras High Court ne observe kiya ki pichhle 10 saalon mein state mein 59 honour killings hui hain [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. Ghar chhodne ke baad koi dhamki de, toh likhit mein report kijiye aur uski copy sambhaal kar rakhiye.

health-cost-of-violence-at-home.en:
Families call it a private matter, something to be settled inside the house. Health data treat it as one of the heaviest burdens on women's health anywhere. Global Burden of Disease estimates published in 2025, cited by the World Health Organization (WHO), rank violence by an intimate partner as the fourth leading cause of poor health among women worldwide [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. In India, one in four women who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband had been injured [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Here is the bill, number by number, with what each figure hides.

## Fourth leading cause of ill health

**4th leading cause.** The ranking is measured in disability-adjusted life years, or DALYs: years of healthy life lost to illness, disability and early death [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. *What it hides:* the ranking is global; it does not give India's place, and it measures lost health, not how many women are affected.

**More depression and anxiety in women.** India's National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 found more mental illness overall among men (13.9%) than women (7.5%), and far more alcohol use disorder (9% of men, 0.5% of women). But depression and anxiety disorders were more common in women [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. *What it hides:* these figures are not broken down by experience of violence, so they cannot say how much of women's depression starts at home. Most of it goes untreated either way: the treatment gap for mental disorders ran from 28% to 83% [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]].

## One in four injured in India

**29.3%.** The share of ever-married women aged 18-49 who reported physical or sexual violence by a husband in NFHS-5 (2019-21) [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

**25%.** One in four of them had been injured [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. *What it hides:* these are answers given face to face to a household survey, and a woman who does not feel safe to speak is not counted, so the real number of injured women may be higher.

**2.7% during pregnancy.** In NFHS-6 (2023-24), 2.7% of ever-married women aged 18-49 reported physical violence during a pregnancy, against 3.1% in NFHS-5 [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. *What it hides:* the indicator does not say who committed the violence, and it comes from provisional fact sheets.

## 6% and 3%: the worst injuries

**6%** of women who faced physical or sexual violence from a husband had deep wounds, broken bones or broken teeth, and **3%** reported severe burns [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. These are survey categories, not accounts of any one woman. Each is an injury that needs a doctor.

Burns carry particular weight in Indian law. Section 80 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, on dowry deaths, begins with a woman's death "caused by any burns or bodily injury" within seven years of marriage [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and police registered 5,737 dowry-death cases in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it hides:* a household survey can only interview the women who survived. The women in police dowry-death figures are, by definition, missing from the survey's.

## 1% to 6% of GDP

**1% to 6% of GDP.** WHO says that in some countries, violence against women costs between 1% and 6% of GDP, through the cost of police, justice, social protection and health services [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. *What it hides:* the range comes from selected country studies. It is not a global estimate, and it is not India's.

**77.2% told no one.** Most violence in India never reaches a public service to be counted: 77.2% of women who faced physical or sexual violence never sought help or told anyone, and only 14.1% sought help [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. So much of the bill is paid inside the home, in health and earnings that no GDP estimate captures.

**0.2% for prevention.** In 2022, only 0.2% of global development aid went to programmes focused on preventing violence against women, and WHO reported that such funding fell further in 2025 [[who-vaw-estimates-2025]].

## What a doctor's visit can change

**2%.** Of the women who did seek help after violence, 61% turned to their own family, 6% to the police and only 2% to a doctor or medical staff [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yet injuries, pregnancies and depression bring women into clinics anyway. That puts health workers, not only police, on the front line, whether or not anyone tells them the cause.

Consider this situation. A 28-year-old woman comes to a district hospital with a broken wrist and says she slipped in the bathroom. If no one asks, the file says "fall", the wrist is set, and she goes home to the same house. If a doctor or nurse asks her, alone, whether someone hurt her, and writes down what she says and what they see, she leaves with treatment, a record and, if she wants it, a referral.

That record can later support a cruelty complaint or a protection order, if she chooses one. The referral can be to a One Stop Centre, which offers integrated support under one roof to women facing violence: 985 were operating in July 2026, and they had assisted over 15.20 lakh women since April 2015 [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. For low mood, panic or thoughts of suicide, Tele-MANAS, the free, round-the-clock mental-health helpline, answers on 14416 [[tele-manas]].

If you are her friend or sister, the most useful thing may be to go with her, and to tell her she can say how it happened.
health-cost-of-violence-at-home.hg:
Families ise ghar ka maamla kehti hain, jo ghar ke andar hi suljhaya jaye. Health data ise duniya bhar mein auraton ki sehat par sabse bhaari bojhon mein se ek maanta hai. 2025 mein publish hue Global Burden of Disease estimates, jinhe World Health Organization (WHO) quote karta hai, intimate partner ki hinsa ko duniya bhar mein auraton ki kharaab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah batate hain [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. India mein, pati ki physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali har chaar mein se ek aurat ko chot lagi thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh raha poora bill, ek-ek number karke, aur har number kya chhupata hai.

## Kharaab sehat ki chauthi sabse badi wajah

**4th leading cause.** Yeh ranking disability-adjusted life years, yaani DALYs, mein naapi jaati hai: bimari, disability aur jaldi maut ki wajah se khoye gaye sehatmand zindagi ke saal [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* ranking global hai; isme India ki jagah nahi batayi gayi, aur yeh khoyi hui sehat naapti hai, yeh nahi ki kitni auratein prabhavit hain.

**Auraton mein depression aur anxiety zyada.** India ke National Mental Health Survey 2015-16 mein overall mental illness mardon mein (13.9%) auraton (7.5%) se zyada mili, aur alcohol use disorder bhi kahin zyada (9% mard, 0.5% auratein). Par depression aur anxiety disorders auraton mein zyada aam the [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* yeh figures hinsa ke anubhav ke hisaab se alag nahi kiye gaye, isliye yeh nahi bata sakte ki auraton ka kitna depression ghar se shuru hota hai. Jo bhi ho, zyada tar ka ilaaj nahi hota: mental disorders ka treatment gap 28% se 83% tak tha [[nimhans-nmhs-summary-2016]].

## India mein har chaar mein se ek ko chot

**29.3%.** NFHS-5 (2019-21) mein 18-49 saal ki itni ever-married auraton ne pati ki physical ya sexual violence report ki [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

**25%.** Inme se har chaar mein se ek ko chot lagi thi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* yeh ek household survey mein aamne-saamne diye gaye jawab hain, aur jo aurat bolne mein surakshit mehsoos nahi karti woh gini nahi jaati, isliye chot khane wali auraton ki asli ginti isse zyada ho sakti hai.

**Pregnancy ke dauraan 2.7%.** NFHS-6 (2023-24) mein 18-49 saal ki 2.7% ever-married auraton ne pregnancy ke dauraan physical violence report ki, jabki NFHS-5 mein yeh 3.1% tha [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* yeh indicator nahi batata ki hinsa kisne ki, aur yeh provisional fact sheets se liya gaya hai.

## 6% aur 3%: sabse gambhir chotein

Pati ki physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali auraton mein se **6%** ko gehre ghaav, tooti haddiyan ya toote daant mile, aur **3%** ne jalne ki gambhir chot batayi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Yeh survey ki categories hain, kisi ek aurat ki kahani nahi. Inme se har chot aisi hai jise doctor ki zaroorat hoti hai.

Indian kanoon mein jalne ka ek khaas wazan hai. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita ka Section 80, jo dowry deaths ke baare mein hai, shaadi ke saat saal ke andar "caused by any burns or bodily injury", yaani jalne ya shareer par chot se hui aurat ki maut se shuru hota hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur 2024 mein police ne dowry death ke 5,737 cases register kiye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* household survey sirf unhi auraton se baat kar sakta hai jo zinda bachi. Police ke dowry death figures mein gini gayi auratein survey mein ho hi nahi sakti.

## GDP ka 1% se 6%

**GDP ka 1% se 6%.** WHO ke mutabik kuch deshon mein auraton ke khilaf hinsa ki keemat GDP ka 1% se 6% tak hai, police, justice, social protection aur health services ke kharche ki wajah se [[who-vaw-factsheet-2026]]. *Yeh kya chhupata hai:* yeh range kuch chune hue deshon ki studies se aayi hai. Yeh na global estimate hai, na India ka.

**77.2% ne kisi ko nahi bataya.** India mein zyada tar hinsa kabhi kisi public service tak pahunchti hi nahi ki gini ja sake: physical ya sexual violence jhelne wali 77.2% auraton ne na madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya, aur sirf 14.1% ne madad maangi [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Isliye bill ka bada hissa ghar ke andar hi chukaya jaata hai, sehat aur kamai mein, jise koi GDP estimate pakad nahi paata.

**Rokthaam ke liye 0.2%.** 2022 mein global development aid ka sirf 0.2% auraton ke khilaf hinsa rokne wale programmes par gaya, aur WHO ke mutabik 2025 mein aisi funding aur ghat gayi [[who-vaw-estimates-2025]].

## Doctor ke paas jaana kya badal sakta hai

**2%.** Hinsa ke baad jin auraton ne madad maangi, unme se 61% apni family ke paas gayi, 6% police ke paas, aur sirf 2% doctor ya medical staff ke paas [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Phir bhi chotein, pregnancies aur depression auraton ko clinic tak le hi aate hain. Isliye front line par sirf police nahi, health workers bhi hain, chahe koi unhe asli wajah bataye ya nahi.

Sochiye, 28 saal ki ek aurat district hospital mein tooti kalai lekar aati hai aur kehti hai ki bathroom mein phisal gayi. Agar koi kuch na poochhe, toh file mein "fall" likha jayega, kalai jod di jayegi, aur woh usi ghar mein laut jayegi. Agar koi doctor ya nurse use akele mein poochhe ki kya kisi ne use chot pahunchayi, aur jo woh kahe aur jo unhe dikhe use likh le, toh woh ilaaj, ek record aur, agar woh chahe, ek referral lekar jaati hai.

Woh record baad mein cruelty ki complaint ya protection order mein kaam aa sakta hai, agar woh yeh raasta chune. Referral kisi One Stop Centre ke liye ho sakta hai, jo hinsa jhel rahi auraton ko ek hi chhat ke neeche integrated support deta hai: July 2026 mein aise 985 centre chal rahe the, aur April 2015 se 15.20 lakh se zyada auraton ki madad kar chuke the [[pib-osc-lok-sabha-2026-07]]. Udaasi, ghabrahat ya suicide ke khayalon ke liye Tele-MANAS, free aur din-raat chalne wali mental health helpline, 14416 par uplabdh hai [[tele-manas]].

Agar aap uski dost ya behen hain, toh sabse kaam ki baat shayad yahi hai ki aap uske saath jaayein, aur use bataayein ki woh doctor ko sach bata sakti hai.

home-crimes-2024-counted-by-the-numbers.en:
Put India's 2024 numbers on violence at home side by side and they do not form one picture. They form a map of what the state can see. Deaths are counted, roughly. Dowry is counted, unevenly. The everyday abuse that a national survey finds in the lives of nearly a third of married women barely registers. Here are ten numbers, what each one measures and what it misses, ranked at the end by how far you can trust them.

## The survey number: 31.9%

**31.9%** of ever-married women in the National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) had faced physical, sexual or emotional violence from a husband, and **26.8%** in the 12 months before they were asked [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Women were asked directly, in a household survey, so this is the closest India has to a measure of how common the violence is.

*What it misses:* it relies on women telling a stranger, and many do not. The newer NFHS-6 (2023-24) puts physical or sexual violence by a husband at 22.3%, down from 29.2% [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]], a fall that experts quoted by Deccan Herald doubt, partly because women may not speak freely with family nearby [[deccanherald-nfhs6-gbv-2026]].

The survey also explains why police numbers are small. Of women who had faced physical or sexual violence, 77.2% never sought help or told anyone, and of those who did seek help, only 6.3% went to the police [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## The police numbers: 1,20,227, 12,343 and 5,737

**1,20,227** cases of cruelty by a husband or his relatives were registered in 2024, the largest single category of crime against women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* registration depends on where you live. Telangana recorded 52.8 cases per lakh women and Bihar 3.0 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], yet in NFHS-5 both were among the states with the most violence by husbands, Bihar at 42.5% and Telangana at 40.4% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. The gap is far more likely to lie in police stations than in homes.

**12,343** cases were filed under the Dowry Prohibition Act [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* West Bengal registered none and Maharashtra 12 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. That reflects police practice, not the absence of dowry.

**5,737** dowry deaths were recorded, with 5,811 victims, about 16 a day [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* dowry death is a legal category, and deaths logged as suicide or accident often never enter it. Dowry was also the recorded motive in **701** murders, which sit in a separate table [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. And because NCRB counts each FIR once, under its most serious offence, cruelty that ends in a dowry death drops out of the cruelty count [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]].

## The tiny numbers: 616 and 36

**616** criminal cases were registered under the 2005 Domestic Violence Act, 496 of them in Kerala [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* almost everything. The Act is mainly civil, giving protection, residence and maintenance orders, and its main offence is breaking a protection order, punishable with up to a year or a Rs 20,000 fine [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. A woman who wins an order from a magistrate never appears here. Even the criminal cases stall: of 4,017 before the courts in 2024, 84 trials finished, 22 with a conviction, and 97.4% were still pending [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**36** murders had "honour killing" recorded as the motive, against 1,391 put down to "love affairs" [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* the count is widely regarded as far too low. India has no separate offence of honour killing, and many such murders are logged under "love affairs" or other motives, or charged as lesser crimes. NCRB shows Tamil Nadu with no honour killings from 2020 to 2023 and one in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]; in June 2026 a Madras High Court judge observed, without citing a source, that the state had seen 59 in ten years [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]].

## Acid and witchcraft: 207 and 54

**207** acid attacks were registered, the same as in 2023, plus 68 attempts; 118 of the attacks were on women [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. This count is firmer than most: an acid injury is hard to hide, and every hospital must treat the survivor free and inform the police [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. *What it misses:* attacks booked under other sections.

**54** murders had witchcraft as the recorded motive, down from 88 in 2020; Madhya Pradesh (17) and Chhattisgarh (10) reported the most [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *What it misses:* assaults, and women driven out of their villages, none of which are murders. NCRB does not even publish the victims' sex.

## Which numbers to trust, and which are a floor

Our ranking, based on how each figure is defined and collected:

| Rank | Numbers | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31.9% and 26.8% | Closest to the real scale, still an undercount |
| 2 | 5,737 dowry deaths, 207 acid attacks | Hard to hide, but shaped by how police classify them |
| 3 | 1,20,227 cruelty cases, 12,343 dowry cases | Real cases, filtered by who reports and which state registers |
| 4 | 701 dowry murders, 54 witchcraft murders | Only killings with a recorded motive: a floor |
| 5 | 616 Domestic Violence Act cases, 36 honour killings | Not a measure of the crime at all |

The pattern is the point. The closer a crime comes to a death certificate, the better India counts it. The closer it stays to an ordinary evening at home, the less the state sees.

Consider a hypothetical woman in Lucknow, slapped, watched and kept from her own salary for six years. If she never goes to a police station, she exists only in a survey. If she wins a protection order, she still does not appear in NCRB's tables. Only if she dies within seven years of her wedding might she be counted, as a dowry death, a dowry murder, an abetted suicide or an accident, depending on one line in an FIR. For her, the protection order is still worth getting: breaking it is a crime, whether or not any statistic records her. Anyone having thoughts of suicide can call Tele-MANAS on 14416, free and round the clock [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].
home-crimes-2024-counted-by-the-numbers.hg:
India ke 2024 ke ghar ki violence wale numbers ko saath-saath rakhiye, toh woh ek tasveer nahi banate. Woh ek map banate hain ki state ko kya dikhta hai. Maut gini jaati hai, mote taur par. Dowry gini jaati hai, adhoore dhang se. Aur roz ka woh abuse jo ek national survey lagbhag har teesri shaadishuda aurat ki zindagi mein paata hai, records mein mushkil se dikhta hai. Yahan das numbers hain: har ek kya naapta hai, kya chhod deta hai, aur aakhir mein unki ranking ki unpar kitna bharosa kiya ja sakta hai.

## Survey ka number: 31.9%

National Family Health Survey (NFHS-5, 2019-21) mein kabhi bhi married rahi **31.9%** auraton ne pati ki physical, sexual ya emotional violence jheli thi, aur **26.8%** ne survey se pehle ke 12 mahino mein [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Ek household survey mein auraton se seedhe poocha gaya, isliye violence kitni common hai, iska yeh India ke paas sabse kareeb ka measure hai.

*Kya chhoot jaata hai:* yeh is baat par tika hai ki aurat ek anjaan insaan ko sach bataye, aur bahut si nahi batatin. Naya NFHS-6 (2023-24) pati ki physical ya sexual violence ko 22.3% par rakhta hai, jo pehle 29.2% thi [[nfhs6-factsheets-2026]]. Deccan Herald se baat karne wale experts is giravat par shak karte hain, kuch had tak isliye ki family ke aas-paas hone par auratein khul kar nahi bol paatin [[deccanherald-nfhs6-gbv-2026]].

Survey yeh bhi samjhata hai ki police ke number itne chhote kyun hain. Physical ya sexual violence jhel chuki auraton mein se 77.2% ne na kabhi madad maangi, na kisi ko bataya, aur jinhone madad maangi, unmein se sirf 6.3% police ke paas gayin [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

## Police ke numbers: 1,20,227, 12,343 aur 5,737

2024 mein pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ke **1,20,227** cases register hue, jo auraton ke khilaf crime ki sabse badi single category hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* registration is par nirbhar hai ki aap kahan rehti hain. Telangana ne har lakh auraton par 52.8 cases record kiye aur Bihar ne 3.0 [[ncrb-cii-2024]], jabki NFHS-5 mein dono un states mein the jahan pati ki violence sabse zyada thi: Bihar 42.5% aur Telangana 40.4% [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Lagta yahi hai ki yeh farak gharon mein kam, police stations mein zyada hai.

Dowry Prohibition Act ke under **12,343** cases file hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* West Bengal ne ek bhi case register nahi kiya aur Maharashtra ne sirf 12 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh police ki practice dikhata hai, dowry ka na hona nahi.

**5,737** dowry deaths record hui, jinme 5,811 victims thin, yaani roz lagbhag 16 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* dowry death ek legal category hai, aur suicide ya accident ke roop mein darj hui maut aksar isme pahunchti hi nahi. Iske alawa **701** murders mein dowry ko motive darj kiya gaya, jo ek alag table mein hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Aur kyunki NCRB har FIR ko sirf ek baar, uske sabse gambhir offence ke under ginta hai, jo cruelty dowry death par khatam hoti hai, woh cruelty ki ginti se bahar ho jaati hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]].

## Chhote numbers: 616 aur 36

2005 ke Domestic Violence Act ke under **616** criminal cases register hue, jinme se 496 Kerala mein [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* lagbhag sab kuch. Yeh Act mainly civil hai, jo protection, residence aur maintenance orders deta hai, aur iska main offence protection order todna hai, jiski saza ek saal tak jail ya Rs 20,000 tak fine hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]]. Jo aurat magistrate se order jeet leti hai, woh yahan kabhi dikhti hi nahi. Criminal cases bhi atke rehte hain: 2024 mein courts ke saamne 4,017 cases mein se sirf 84 trials poore hue, 22 mein conviction hua, aur 97.4% ab bhi pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

**36** murders mein motive "honour killing" darj hua, jabki 1,391 ko "love affairs" ke khaate mein daala gaya [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* yeh ginti bahut kam maani jaati hai. India mein honour killing ka koi alag offence nahi hai, aur aise bahut se murders "love affairs" ya doosre motives mein darj hote hain, ya halke crimes ke roop mein charge hote hain. NCRB ke hisaab se Tamil Nadu mein 2020 se 2023 tak ek bhi honour killing nahi hui aur 2024 mein sirf ek [[ncrb-cii-2024]]; June 2026 mein Madras High Court ke ek judge ne, bina koi source bataye, kaha ki state mein das saal mein 59 honour killings hui hain [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]].

## Acid aur witchcraft: 207 aur 54

**207** acid attacks register hue, utne hi jitne 2023 mein, aur 68 attempts alag se; inmein se 118 attacks auraton par the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Yeh ginti zyada-tar numbers se pakki hai: acid ki chot chhupana mushkil hai, aur har hospital ko survivor ka free ilaaj karna aur police ko inform karna zaroori hai [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* woh attacks jo doosre sections mein darj hote hain.

**54** murders mein motive witchcraft darj hua, jo 2020 mein 88 the; sabse zyada cases Madhya Pradesh (17) aur Chhattisgarh (10) se aaye [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. *Kya chhoot jaata hai:* maar-peet, aur gaon se nikaali gayi auratein, kyunki inmein se koi murder nahi hai. NCRB victims ka sex tak publish nahi karta.

## Kin numbers par bharosa karein, aur kaunse sirf floor hain

Hamari ranking, is aadhar par ki har figure kaise define aur collect hota hai:

| Rank | Numbers | Faisla |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | 31.9% aur 26.8% | Asli scale ke sabse kareeb, phir bhi undercount |
| 2 | 5,737 dowry deaths, 207 acid attacks | Chhupana mushkil, par police kaise classify karti hai, us par nirbhar |
| 3 | 1,20,227 cruelty cases, 12,343 dowry cases | Asli cases, par kaun report karta hai aur kaunsa state register karta hai, isse filter hue |
| 4 | 701 dowry murders, 54 witchcraft murders | Sirf woh killings jinka motive darj hua: ek floor |
| 5 | Domestic Violence Act ke 616 cases, 36 honour killings | Crime ka measure hi nahi |

Pattern hi asli baat hai. Crime jitna death certificate ke kareeb aata hai, India use utna behtar ginta hai. Woh jitna ghar ki ek aam shaam ke kareeb rehta hai, state ko utna kam dikhta hai.

Lucknow ki ek hypothetical aurat sochiye: chhe saal se thappad, nigrani, aur apni hi salary se door rakhi gayi. Agar woh kabhi police station nahi jaati, toh woh sirf ek survey mein exist karti hai. Agar use protection order mil jaata hai, tab bhi woh NCRB ki tables mein nahi dikhti. Sirf agar shaadi ke saat saal ke andar uski maut ho jaaye, tab shayad woh gini jaaye: dowry death, dowry murder, abetted suicide ya accident ke roop mein, is par nirbhar ki FIR ki ek line mein kya likha gaya. Uske liye protection order phir bhi lene layak hai: use todna crime hai, chahe koi statistic use record kare ya na kare. Agar kisi ke mann mein suicide ke khayal aa rahe hain, toh woh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kar sakta hai; yeh free hai aur din-raat chalta hai [[pib-garima-greh-lok-sabha-2025]].

home-violence-law-timeline-1961-2026.en:
What happens inside an Indian home was long treated as a family matter, and the law came to the door in stages, years apart. Line the stages up and a pattern appears: each new law named a harm, and each left a gap that the data still shows. This timeline runs from the 1961 dowry ban to the marital rape hearing the Supreme Court has promised for December 2026. It is general information, not legal advice.

## 1961: dowry outlawed, givers included

The Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 made the transaction itself illegal, on both sides. As amended, it punishes giving, taking or abetting dowry with at least five years in prison and a fine of at least Rs 15,000 or the dowry's value, whichever is more, and demanding dowry with six months to two years. The offences are non-bailable [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]]. On paper, the family that pays breaks the law as surely as the family that takes.

**The gap:** in 2024 police registered 12,343 cases under the Act, courts convicted in only 17.4% of the cases they decided, and 83,298 were still pending at year end [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The same year India recorded 5,737 dowry deaths, now an offence under Section 80 of the BNS, about 16 a day [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 2005: a civil law for domestic violence

The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 took a different route from the criminal law. It is mainly civil: a magistrate can order protection, a right to stay in the home and maintenance. It counts "sexual abuse", any sexual conduct that abuses, humiliates, degrades or violates a woman's dignity, as domestic violence. Its only crimes are breaching a protection order and a Protection Officer's failure of duty, each punishable with at most a year in prison or a Rs 20,000 fine [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

**The gap:** because the Act works through magistrates' orders, national crime data barely sees it. India registered only 616 criminal cases under it in 2024, 496 of them in Kerala, and applications for protection orders are not counted at all. Of 4,017 such criminal cases before the courts that year, trials finished in 84 and 22 ended in conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 2013: acid attacks named, acid sales regulated

After the 2012 Delhi gang rape, the Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 created new offences: acid attack (Sections 326A and 326B), sexual harassment, disrobing, voyeurism and stalking [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. On 18 July 2013, in Laxmi v. Union of India, the Supreme Court barred over-the-counter acid sales unless the seller kept a register of buyers. Buyers had to show government photo ID and state a purpose, nobody under 18 could buy, and sellers could be fined up to Rs 50,000. Every survivor was to get at least Rs 3 lakh [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. Today Section 124 of the BNS punishes an acid attack with at least 10 years and up to life [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**The gap:** police registered 202 acid attacks in 2022, 207 in 2023 and 207 in 2024. Of 804 acid-attack cases on women before the courts in 2024, 24 trials finished and 13 ended in conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. On 27 October 2026 the Supreme Court told the Centre its acid-sale guidelines had "miserably failed" [[livelaw-acid-policy-failure-2026]].

## 2018: the right to choose a partner

In March 2018, in Shakti Vahini v. Union of India, the Supreme Court held that the right to choose a life partner is a facet of individual liberty, and ordered preventive, remedial and punitive measures to protect couples from "honour" crimes [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. The Law Commission had proposed a special law in August 2012; it was still unimplemented when the court's amicus curiae urged it in January 2018 [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]], and the BNS created no separate offence of honour killing.

**The gap:** police recorded only 36 murders with "honour killing" as the motive in 2024, against 1,391 attributed to "love affairs" [[ncrb-cii-2024]], a count widely regarded as far too low. In December 2025 the Delhi High Court was told that Delhi had no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases, more than seven years after the judgment [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

## 2024-2026: a new code, an old exception, a hearing

The Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), enacted in December 2023, came into force on 1 July 2024 and replaced the Indian Penal Code [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It renumbered the home's crimes: cruelty by a husband or his relatives is now Section 85, punishable with up to three years [[indiacode-bns-2023]], and it was the largest single category of crime against women in 2024, with 1,20,227 cases [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The BNS also kept the marital rape exception. Exception 2 to Section 63 says sexual intercourse or sexual acts by a man with his own wife, if she is not under 18, is not rape [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The 2013 amendment had kept it for wives aged 15 and above; the Supreme Court read it down to protect wives under 18 in 2017 and left adult wives undecided [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. In December 2024 the government told the Rajya Sabha it had no proposal to criminalise marital rape, pointing instead to the 2005 Act and other sections, including cruelty [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]].

That leaves a contradiction inside the same home. Forced sex by a husband can be "sexual abuse" under the 2005 Act and "not rape" under the penal code. As of 19 November 2026 the Supreme Court had not ruled, and said it would fix the final hearing on 9 or 10 December 2026 [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Every law on this list is still usable. A woman facing violence at home can seek a protection order, report cruelty or a dowry demand to the police, and call the Women Helpline or 112. But 65 years of dates show that naming a harm in law is where protection starts, not where it ends. Whether it reaches a woman depends on police who register, courts that finish trials, and a hearing that is now weeks away.
home-violence-law-timeline-1961-2026.hg:
Indian ghar ke andar jo hota hai, use lambe samay tak "family ka maamla" maana gaya, aur law ghar ki dehleez tak kai saalon ke faasle par, kadam-ba-kadam pahuncha. In kadmon ko ek line mein rakhiye toh ek pattern dikhta hai: har naye law ne ek nuksaan ko naam diya, aur har law ek aisa gap chhod gaya jo data mein aaj bhi dikhta hai. Yeh timeline 1961 ke dowry ban se shuru hokar us marital rape hearing tak jaati hai jiska Supreme Court ne December 2026 ke liye vaada kiya hai. Yeh general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## 1961: dowry gair-kaanooni, dene wale bhi daayre mein

Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961 ne is len-den ko hi gair-kaanooni bana diya, dono taraf se. Amendments ke baad aaj yeh Act dowry dene, lene ya usmein madad karne par kam se kam paanch saal ki jail aur kam se kam Rs 15,000 ya dowry ki keemat, jo bhi zyada ho, ka fine rakhta hai, aur dowry maangne par chhe mahine se do saal tak ki saza. Yeh offences non-bailable hain [[indiacode-dowry-prohibition-1961]]. Kaagaz par, dowry dene wali family bhi utna hi law todti hai jitna lene wali.

**Gap:** 2024 mein police ne is Act ke tahat 12,343 cases register kiye, courts ne jin cases ka faisla kiya unmein se sirf 17.4% mein conviction hua, aur saal ke end mein 83,298 cases pending the [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Usi saal India mein 5,737 dowry deaths darj huin, yaani lagbhag 16 roz; dowry death ab BNS ke Section 80 ke tahat offence hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 2005: domestic violence ke liye ek civil law

Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 ne criminal law se alag raasta liya. Yeh mainly civil law hai: magistrate protection, ghar mein rehne ke haq aur maintenance ke orders de sakta hai. Yeh "sexual abuse" ko, yaani aisa koi bhi sexual behaviour jo aurat ki dignity ko thes pahunchaye, use neecha dikhaye ya uska apmaan kare, domestic violence maanta hai. Iske tahat sirf do crimes hain: protection order todna, aur Protection Officer ka apni duty na nibhaana. Dono par zyada se zyada ek saal ki jail ya Rs 20,000 ka fine hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

**Gap:** kyunki yeh Act magistrate ke orders se chalta hai, national crime data ise mushkil se dekh paata hai. 2024 mein poore India mein iske tahat sirf 616 criminal cases register hue, jinmein se 496 Kerala mein the, aur protection order ki applications toh gini hi nahi jaatin. Usi saal courts ke saamne aise 4,017 criminal cases the; sirf 84 ka trial poora hua aur 22 mein conviction hua [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

## 2013: acid attack ko naam mila, acid ki bikri par lagaam

2012 ke Delhi gang rape ke baad Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 2013 ne naye offences banaye: acid attack (Sections 326A aur 326B), sexual harassment, disrobing, voyeurism aur stalking [[gazette-criminal-law-amendment-act-2013]]. 18 July 2013 ko Laxmi v. Union of India mein Supreme Court ne over-the-counter acid ki bikri par rok laga di, jab tak seller khareedaron ka register na rakhe. Khareedar ko government photo ID dikhani thi aur maqsad batana tha, 18 se kam umr ke kisi ko acid nahi becha ja sakta tha, aur seller par Rs 50,000 tak ka fine lag sakta tha. Har survivor ko kam se kam Rs 3 lakh milne the [[sc-laxmi-2013]]. Aaj BNS ka Section 124 acid attack par kam se kam 10 saal aur life tak ki saza deta hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]].

**Gap:** police ne 2022 mein 202, 2023 mein 207 aur 2024 mein 207 acid attacks register kiye. 2024 mein women par acid attack ke 804 cases courts ke saamne the; sirf 24 trials poore hue aur 13 mein conviction hua [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. 27 October 2026 ko Supreme Court ne Centre se kaha ki uski acid-sale guidelines "miserably failed" ho gayi hain, yaani buri tarah naakaam rahi hain [[livelaw-acid-policy-failure-2026]].

## 2018: partner chunne ka haq

March 2018 mein Shakti Vahini v. Union of India mein Supreme Court ne kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur couples ko "honour" crimes se bachane ke liye preventive, remedial aur punitive measures ka order diya [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Law Commission ne August 2012 mein ek special law ka proposal diya tha; January 2018 mein jab court ke amicus curiae ne use apnaane ki maang ki, tab bhi woh laagu nahi hua tha [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]], aur BNS mein bhi honour killing ka koi alag offence nahi banaya gaya.

**Gap:** 2024 mein police ne sirf 36 murders mein motive "honour killing" darj kiya, jabki 1,391 murders "love affairs" ke naam darj hue [[ncrb-cii-2024]], aur is count ko aam taur par bahut kam maana jaata hai. December 2025 mein Delhi High Court ko bataya gaya ki Delhi mein honour killing cases ke liye ek bhi fast-track court nahi bana, judgment ke saat saal se zyada baad bhi [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

## 2024-2026: naya code, purana exception, ek hearing

Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) December 2023 mein bani, 1 July 2024 ko laagu hui aur usne Indian Penal Code ki jagah le li [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Isne ghar ke crimes ke section numbers badal diye: pati ya uske relatives ki cruelty ab Section 85 hai, jis par teen saal tak ki saza hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]], aur 2024 mein yeh women ke khilaaf crime ki sabse badi akeli category thi, 1,20,227 cases ke saath [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

BNS ne marital rape exception bhi bana rehne diya. Section 63 ka Exception 2 kehta hai ki kisi aadmi ka apni wife ke saath sexual intercourse ya sexual acts, agar wife 18 se kam ki nahi hai, rape nahi hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2013 ke amendment ne yeh exception 15 saal aur usse badi wives ke liye rakha tha; 2017 mein Supreme Court ne ise read down karke 18 se kam umr ki wives ko bachaaya aur adult wives ka sawaal khula chhod diya [[sc-independent-thought-2017]]. December 2024 mein government ne Rajya Sabha ko bataya ki marital rape ko crime banane ka uska koi proposal nahi hai, aur iske bajaaye 2005 ke Act aur cruelty samet doosre sections ki taraf ishaara kiya [[scroll-no-proposal-marital-rape-2024]].

Isse ek hi ghar ke andar ek virodhabhaas ban jaata hai. Pati ka zabardasti sex 2005 ke Act ke tahat "sexual abuse" ho sakta hai, aur penal code ke tahat "not rape". 19 November 2026 tak Supreme Court ne faisla nahi diya tha, aur kaha tha ki woh final hearing 9 ya 10 December 2026 ko rakhega [[lawbeat-marital-rape-hearing-2026]].

Is list ka har law aaj bhi kaam aa sakta hai. Ghar mein violence jhel rahi aurat protection order maang sakti hai, cruelty ya dowry ki maang ki report police mein kar sakti hai, aur Women Helpline ya 112 par call kar sakti hai. Lekin 65 saal ki taareekhen dikhati hain ki kisi nuksaan ko law mein naam dena hifaazat ki shuruaat hai, ant nahi. Woh hifaazat aurat tak pahunchegi ya nahi, yeh us police par tika hai jo case register kare, un courts par jo trial poore karein, aur us hearing par jo ab kuch hi hafte door hai.

honour-killings-undercount-tamil-nadu.en:
Tamil Nadu's police reported no honour killings to the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) in 2020. None in 2021, none in 2022, none in 2023. In 2024, they reported one [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. In June 2026, a judge of the Madras High Court, hearing a bail plea in a 2025 killing in Tirunelveli district, observed that the state had seen 59 honour killings over the past ten years [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. The two figures are very hard to reconcile. This investigation follows the gap: how a killing gets its label, who has reasons to leave the label off, and what an honest count would need.

## The official count: 18 to 38 a year

For the whole country, NCRB recorded 25 honour killings in 2020, 33 in 2021, 18 in 2022, 38 in 2023 and 36 in 2024 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. These are not counts of a crime. Neither the IPC nor the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) that replaced it in 2024 has an offence called honour killing; such killings are prosecuted as murder or under other general sections [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]]. The Law Commission proposed a special law in its 242nd Report in August 2012. It was still unimplemented when the Supreme Court's amicus curiae urged its adoption in January 2018 [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]].

So "honour killing" is a motive: a label police attach to a murder case. In 2024 they attached it to 36 murders, and attached "love affairs" to 1,391 [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Nothing in the table shows how many of those 1,391 people were killed by a family that objected to a relationship.

## Tamil Nadu: zero in the tables, 59 in court

| Year | Honour killings recorded in Tamil Nadu |
|---|---|
| 2020 | 0 |
| 2021 | 0 |
| 2022 | 0 |
| 2023 | 0 |
| 2024 | 1 |

These are the state's rows in NCRB's murder-motive tables [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Justice B. Pugalendhi's 59 comes from a judgment dated 11 June 2026 that does not say where the count comes from, and its ten-year window is longer than the five years above [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. But for both sets of numbers to be right, nearly all of the 59 killings would have to fall outside those five years. The judge also said that deep-rooted casteism in people's minds was spoiling the entire system [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]].

Whether the 2025 killing before him appears in the "honour" column of NCRB's 2025 figures for Tamil Nadu will be a small test of whether anything has changed.

## How a motive gets written down

NCRB does not investigate. It compiles what state and union territory police send, and says it is not responsible for the information's authenticity [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. It counts each FIR once, under the offence with the heaviest punishment: the "principal offence rule" [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. And its motive table covers only cases booked as murder, under Section 103 BNS or, before July 2024, Section 302 IPC [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Consider a hypothetical. A 24-year-old woman in a Tamil Nadu town marries a man from another caste against her parents' wishes. Months later, he is killed. If the investigation records the family's opposition to the marriage, the case can be counted as an honour killing. If it records a quarrel or a "love affair", it lands in another column. If the accused are charged with something less than murder, it leaves the motive table entirely.

The people with the most influence over that label can have reasons to leave it off. The accused are relatives, and so, often, are the people best placed to explain the motive. An honour label can also tell everyone that a couple was in danger and nobody protected them. Caste adds one more decision: where the person killed was from a Scheduled Caste, NCRB counts the crime as an atrocity only if police invoke the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

## Charged as a lesser offence: the April 2025 case

In April 2025, the Supreme Court took up a killing from Uttar Pradesh in which police had pressed only culpable homicide not amounting to murder, and the trial court and the Allahabad High Court had let that stand. A bench of Chief Justice Sanjiv Khanna and Justice P.V. Sanjay Kumar set those orders aside, said "This is a clear case of honour killing" and directed a fresh charge of murder under Section 302 IPC, the law that applied at the time [[barandbench-honour-killing-lesser-charge-2025]]. Its equivalent today is Section 103 BNS.

The charge matters twice. It decides the punishment, and it decides the record: a killing tried as culpable homicide is not a murder in NCRB's tables, so it can never be counted as an honour killing. This case was corrected because it reached the Supreme Court. Most cases never get that far.

## What an honest count would take

The Supreme Court has already said what the state owes couples. In Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018), it held that the right to choose a life partner is part of individual liberty, and ordered preventive, remedial and punitive measures against honour crimes [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Its directions included special cells, fast-track and special courts, and district-level monitoring committees. In December 2025, more than seven years later, the Delhi High Court was told that Delhi still had no fast-track courts for honour-killing cases [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

An honest count would need:

- **a flag that follows the case**: once police find that a family opposed a relationship, the case is marked, whether it is booked as murder, attempt to murder or culpable homicide;
- **the special cells' records, published** district by district: how many couples asked for protection, and how many were attacked;
- **the source of the 59**, released and checked against what Tamil Nadu sent to NCRB;
- **the victim's sex, age and relationship to the accused** in the motive tables.

Until then, read every national honour-killing figure as a floor. And if a couple you know is being threatened over who they love, do not wait for the statistics: call 112 and put every threat in writing to the police.
honour-killings-undercount-tamil-nadu.hg:
Tamil Nadu police ne 2020 mein National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) ko ek bhi honour killing report nahi ki. 2021 mein bhi nahi, 2022 mein bhi nahi, 2023 mein bhi nahi. 2024 mein ek report ki [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. June 2026 mein Madras High Court ke ek judge ne, Tirunelveli district ki 2025 ki ek killing mein bail plea sunte hue, kaha ki pichhle das saal mein state mein 59 honour killings hui hain [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. In dono aankdon ka ek saath sahi hona bahut mushkil hai. Yeh investigation isi gap ka peecha karti hai: ek killing ko uska label kaise milta hai, kisko woh label hatane ki wajah milti hai, aur ek imaandaar count ke liye kya chahiye.

## Official count: saal mein 18 se 38

Poore desh ke liye NCRB ne 2020 mein 25 honour killings darj kin, 2021 mein 33, 2022 mein 18, 2023 mein 38 aur 2024 mein 36 [[ncrb-cii-2023]]. Yeh kisi crime ki ginti nahi hai. Na IPC mein "honour killing" naam ka koi offence tha, na 2024 mein uski jagah aaye Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) mein hai; aisi killings murder ya doosre general sections mein chalayi jaati hain [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]]. Law Commission ne August 2012 mein apni 242nd Report mein ek special law ka proposal diya tha. January 2018 mein jab Supreme Court ke amicus curiae ne use apnane ki maang ki, tab bhi woh lagu nahi hua tha [[livelaw-honour-killing-amicus-2018]].

Matlab "honour killing" ek motive hai: ek label jo police murder case par lagati hai. 2024 mein yeh label 36 murders par laga, aur "love affairs" ka label 1,391 par [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Table yeh nahi batati ki un 1,391 logon mein se kitnon ko us family ne maara jo kisi rishte ke khilaf thi.

## Tamil Nadu: tables mein zero, court mein 59

| Saal | Tamil Nadu mein darj honour killings |
|---|---|
| 2020 | 0 |
| 2021 | 0 |
| 2022 | 0 |
| 2023 | 0 |
| 2024 | 1 |

Yeh NCRB ki murder-motive tables mein state ki rows hain [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Justice B. Pugalendhi ka 59 ka aankda 11 June 2026 ke ek judgment se aata hai, jo yeh nahi batata ki yeh ginti kahan se aayi, aur uski das saal ki window upar ke paanch saalon se lambi hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]]. Lekin dono sets of numbers tabhi sahi ho sakte hain jab 59 mein se lagbhag saari killings in paanch saalon ke bahar hui hon. Judge ne yeh bhi kaha ki logon ke dimaag mein gehra baitha casteism poore system ko bigaad raha hai [[livelaw-madras-hc-honour-killings-2026]].

Unke saamne aayi 2025 ki killing NCRB ke Tamil Nadu ke 2025 figures mein "honour" column mein dikhti hai ya nahi, yeh ek chhota sa test hoga ki kuch badla hai ya nahi.

## Motive kaise likha jaata hai

NCRB khud investigation nahi karta. State aur union territory police jo bhejti hai, woh use compile karta hai, aur kehta hai ki us information ki authenticity ki zimmedari uski nahi hai [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Woh har FIR ko ek hi baar ginta hai, us offence ke naam se jiski saza sabse bhaari ho: yeh "principal offence rule" hai [[ncrb-cii-2024-methodology]]. Aur uski motive table sirf un cases ko cover karti hai jo murder mein darj hue, Section 103 BNS ke under ya July 2024 se pehle Section 302 IPC ke under [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Ek hypothetical socho. Tamil Nadu ke ek town ki 24 saal ki ladki apne maa-baap ki marzi ke khilaf doosri caste ke ladke se shaadi karti hai. Kuch mahine baad ladke ki hatya ho jaati hai. Agar investigation mein shaadi par family ka virodh darj hota hai, toh case honour killing gina ja sakta hai. Agar jhagda ya "love affair" darj hota hai, toh woh kisi aur column mein chala jaata hai. Agar accused par murder se halka charge lagta hai, toh case motive table se hi bahar ho jaata hai.

Jinke haath mein is label par sabse zyada asar hai, unke paas use hatane ki wajahein ho sakti hain. Accused rishtedaar hote hain, aur aksar motive samjhane ke liye sabse sahi log bhi wahi rishtedaar hote hain. Honour ka label sabko yeh bhi bata sakta hai ki ek couple khatre mein tha aur kisi ne unhe nahi bachaya. Caste ek aur faisla jod deti hai: agar maara gaya insaan Scheduled Caste se tha, toh NCRB crime ko atrocity tabhi ginta hai jab police SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act lagaye [[ncrb-cii-2023-vol2]].

## Halka charge: April 2025 ka case

April 2025 mein Supreme Court ne Uttar Pradesh ki ek killing ka case liya, jisme police ne sirf culpable homicide not amounting to murder ka charge lagaya tha, aur trial court aur Allahabad High Court ne use chalne diya tha. Chief Justice Sanjiv Khanna aur Justice P.V. Sanjay Kumar ki bench ne woh orders radd kiye, kaha "This is a clear case of honour killing", aur Section 302 IPC ke under, jo us waqt lagu law tha, murder ka naya charge lagane ka direction diya [[barandbench-honour-killing-lesser-charge-2025]]. Aaj iska equivalent Section 103 BNS hai.

Charge do baar maayne rakhta hai. Woh saza tay karta hai, aur record bhi: culpable homicide ke roop mein chala case NCRB ki tables mein murder hai hi nahi, isliye use kabhi honour killing gina hi nahi ja sakta. Yeh case isliye sudhra kyunki woh Supreme Court tak pahuncha. Zyada tar cases wahan tak kabhi nahi pahunchte.

## Imaandaar count ke liye kya chahiye

Supreme Court pehle hi bata chuka hai ki state ko couples ke liye kya karna hai. Shakti Vahini v. Union of India (2018) mein court ne kaha ki life partner chunne ka haq individual liberty ka hissa hai, aur honour crimes ke khilaf preventive, remedial aur punitive measures ka order diya [[barandbench-shakti-vahini-madras-pil-2021]]. Iske directions mein special cells, fast-track aur special courts, aur district-level monitoring committees shaamil thi. December 2025 mein, saat saal se zyada baad, Delhi High Court ko bataya gaya ki Delhi mein abhi tak honour killing cases ke liye ek bhi fast-track court nahi bana [[barandbench-honour-killing-fast-track-2025]].

Ek imaandaar count ke liye chahiye:

- **case ke saath chalne wala flag**: jaise hi police ko pata chale ki family kisi rishte ke khilaf thi, case mark ho, chahe woh murder, attempt to murder ya culpable homicide mein darj ho;
- **special cells ke records, public**, district-wise: kitne couples ne protection maangi, aur kitno par hamla hua;
- **59 ka source**, public kiya jaye aur us data se milaya jaye jo Tamil Nadu ne NCRB ko bheja;
- **victim ka sex, umar aur accused se rishta** motive tables mein.

Tab tak honour killing ke har national figure ko ek floor samjho, poori ginti nahi. Aur agar aapke jaan-pehchaan ka koi couple apni pasand ki wajah se dhamkiyan jhel raha hai, toh statistics ka intezaar mat karo: 112 par call karo aur har dhamki police ko likh kar do.

in-laws-joint-family-abuse-law.en:
Indian criminal law does not stop at the husband. Section 85 of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS), the cruelty law, begins: "Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman" [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. The wording fits how many Indian marriages work: a woman often moves into her husband's family home and lives under his parents' rules. This explainer is general information, not legal advice.

## Why the law names relatives

Section 85 punishes a husband or his relative who subjects a woman to cruelty with up to three years in prison and a fine. Section 86 defines cruelty as wilful conduct likely to drive her to suicide or to cause grave injury or danger to her life, limb or health, mental or physical, or as harassment to force her or her family to meet an unlawful demand for property [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Until 1 July 2024 the same offence was Section 498A of the IPC.

It is the most registered crime against women in India: 1,20,227 cases in 2024, 27.2% of the total [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. The police category is "husband or his relatives", so the data cannot say how many cases name a mother-in-law, a father-in-law or a brother-in-law.

Global data show why relatives matter. Outside Europe and the Americas, in countries with data, 59% of women and girls killed by partners or family members in 2023 were killed by family members other than partners; in Europe, 64% were killed by partners [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. Where women live inside extended families, the danger is not only the husband.

## 'Disrespect to in-laws': the most accepted excuse

NFHS-5 (2019-21) asked whether a husband is justified in beating his wife in a list of situations. The reason accepted most often was "if she shows disrespect for her in-laws": 32% of women and 31% of men agreed. Refusing sex was accepted least, by 11% of women and 10% of men [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Read that again. The most accepted reason to hit a wife is not about the husband at all. It is about her place in his family. In practice, "disrespect" can mean answering back, visiting her own parents without asking, or saying no to a demand. And because about a third of women agree, many daughters-in-law have been taught the excuse too, which makes the abuse harder to name, even to themselves.

## Power in a joint family

Consider this situation. A 23-year-old moves into her husband's family home in Meerut. Her mother-in-law decides when she may visit her parents. Her father-in-law keeps her salary "for the household". Her husband's brother checks her phone. Her husband stays silent, because his parents' word is final. No single act looks like a crime. Together they are control, and when the control is challenged, it can turn into violence.

The law recognises this power elsewhere too. Under the PCPNDT Act, which bans sex selection, a court must presume that a pregnant woman who sought it was compelled by her husband or relatives, and a woman who was forced is not punished [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. The Domestic Violence Act lets a wife name her husband's relatives in her application, and protects her right to live in the shared household [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Her own family is usually her first door. Of women who sought help after physical or sexual violence, 60.9% turned to their own family [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. In a joint-family dispute, that often means her parents negotiating with his.

## Section 80 and the presumption against in-laws

The law's strongest words against in-laws are in Section 80 BNS. If a woman dies of burns, bodily injury or in abnormal circumstances within seven years of marriage, and it is shown that soon before her death her husband or any relative of her husband subjected her to cruelty or harassment over dowry, it is a "dowry death". The husband or relative is deemed to have caused it, and the punishment is seven years to life [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. Police registered 5,737 dowry deaths in 2024, about 16 a day [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

The presumption matters because a death inside a marital home may have no outside witness, and the people who know what happened may be the accused. But it does not convict a whole family. It attaches to the person shown to have harassed her. That is why the record a woman leaves while alive, of who demanded what and who did what, can decide a case. If this brings up thoughts of suicide for you or someone you know, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 [[tele-manas]].

## What a daughter-in-law and her parents can do

Name each person and each act. "My in-laws harass me" is weak. "On 3 March my mother-in-law took my salary card; on 10 March my husband's brother hit me when I asked for it back" is a complaint police can investigate. A complaint that makes only sweeping charges against the whole family is hard to investigate and easy to dispute. Being specific protects the case, and it is fair to relatives who did nothing.

Know the police steps. Any police station must record a cognizable offence wherever it happened, a complaint sent electronically must be signed within three days, and the FIR copy is free [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. Because cruelty carries up to three years, police may, with a Deputy Superintendent's permission, first hold a preliminary enquiry of up to 14 days [[indiacode-bnss-2023]]. If a station refuses, write to the Superintendent of Police, then approach a magistrate.

Use the civil route too. A Domestic Violence Act application to a magistrate, through a Protection Officer, a lawyer or a One Stop Centre, can stop the abuse and keep her in her home without waiting for a criminal trial [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Parents, do not rush a compromise. In 2024, 16,396 cruelty cases in court ended in compromise, more than the 10,689 that ended in conviction [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Some were genuine reconciliations; the data cannot show how many were pressure on the woman. Ask your daughter what she wants, and tell her she can come home.
in-laws-joint-family-abuse-law.hg:
Indian criminal law sirf pati par nahi rukta. Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) ka Section 85, yaani cruelty ka law, in shabdon se shuru hota hai: "Whoever, being the husband or the relative of the husband of a woman" [[indiacode-bns-2023]], yaani jo koi kisi aurat ka pati ya pati ka relative hokar. Yeh wording bahut si Indian shaadiyon ki sachchai se mel khaati hai: aksar aurat pati ke family ghar mein jaakar rehti hai, uske maa-baap ke rules ke neeche. Yeh explainer general information hai, legal advice nahi.

## Law relatives ka naam kyun leta hai

Section 85 us pati ya uske relative ko teen saal tak ki jail aur fine ki saza deta hai jo kisi aurat ke saath cruelty kare. Section 86 cruelty ki definition deta hai: jaan-boojhkar kiya gaya aisa bartaav jo use suicide ki taraf dhakel sakta ho, ya uski jaan, sharir ya sehat ko, mental ho ya physical, gambhir chot ya khatra pahuncha sakta ho; ya aisi harassment jo use ya uski family ko property ki kisi illegal demand ko poora karne par majboor kare [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 1 July 2024 se pehle yahi offence IPC ka Section 498A tha.

Yeh India mein auraton ke khilaf sabse zyada register hone wala crime hai: 2024 mein 1,20,227 cases, kul ka 27.2% [[ncrb-cii-2024]]. Police ki category "husband or his relatives" hai, isliye data yeh nahi bata sakta ki kitne cases mein saas, sasur ya devar ka naam hai.

Duniya ka data dikhata hai ki relatives kyun maayne rakhte hain. Europe aur Americas ke bahar, jin deshon ka data hai, wahan 2023 mein partners ya family members ke haathon maari gayi auraton aur ladkiyon mein se 59% ko partners ne nahi, doosre family members ne maara; Europe mein 64% ko partners ne maara [[unodc-unwomen-femicides-2023]]. Jahan auratein badi joint families ke andar rehti hain, wahan khatra sirf pati se nahi hota.

## 'Sasural ki disrespect': sabse zyada maana jaane wala bahana

NFHS-5 (2019-21) ne poocha ki kin situations mein pati ka biwi ko peetna sahi hai. Sabse zyada log jis wajah par sehmat the, woh thi "agar woh sasural walon ki disrespect kare": 32% auratein aur 31% mard. Sabse kam log sex se mana karne ko wajah maante the: 11% auratein aur 10% mard [[nfhs5-india-2021]].

Ise phir se padhiye. Biwi ko maarne ki sabse zyada maani jaane wali wajah pati ke baare mein hai hi nahi. Yeh uske parivaar mein biwi ki "jagah" ke baare mein hai. Asal zindagi mein "disrespect" ka matlab ho sakta hai palat kar jawab dena, bina pooche apne maa-baap se milne jaana, ya kisi demand ko na kehna. Aur kyunki qareeb ek-tihaai auratein isse sehmat hain, bahut si bahuon ko bhi yahi bahana sikhaya gaya hai, jisse abuse ko naam dena mushkil ho jaata hai, khud apne aap ke saamne bhi.

## Joint family mein power

Sochiye. 23 saal ki ek ladki Meerut mein pati ke family ghar mein rehne aati hai. Saas tay karti hai ki woh apne maa-baap se kab mil sakti hai. Sasur "ghar ke liye" uski salary rakh lete hain. Devar uska phone check karta hai. Pati chup rehta hai, kyunki uske maa-baap ki baat aakhri hai. Akele koi ek kaam crime jaisa nahi lagta. Saath milkar yeh control hai, aur jab is control ko chunauti milti hai, toh yeh violence ban sakta hai.

Law yeh power doosri jagah bhi maanta hai. Sex selection par ban lagane wale PCPNDT Act mein court ko maanna hota hai ki jis pregnant aurat ne sex selection karwana chaha, use uske pati ya relatives ne majboor kiya tha, aur jis aurat ko majboor kiya gaya use saza nahi milti [[goi-pcpndt-act-1994]]. Domestic Violence Act biwi ko apni application mein pati ke relatives ka naam lene deta hai, aur shared ghar mein rehne ke uske haq ki hifazat karta hai [[indiacode-pwdva-2005]].

Uski apni family aksar uska pehla darwaza hoti hai. Physical ya sexual violence ke baad madad maangne wali auraton mein se 60.9% ne apni family ka sahara liya [[nfhs5-india-2021]]. Joint family ke jhagde mein iska matlab aksar hota hai uske maa-baap ka uske sasural walon se baat karna.

## Section 80 aur sasural ke khilaf presumption

Sasural walon ke khilaf law ke sabse sakht shabd Section 80 BNS mein hain. Agar shaadi ke saat saal ke andar kisi aurat ki maut jalne se, sharir par chot se ya abnormal circumstances mein ho, aur yeh dikhaya jaye ki maut se kuch hi pehle uske pati ya pati ke kisi relative ne dowry ke liye uske saath cruelty ya harassment ki thi, toh yeh "dowry death" hai. Law maan leta hai ki maut usi pati ya relative ne ki, aur saza saat saal se life imprisonment tak hai [[indiacode-bns-2023]]. 2024 mein police ne 5,737 dowry deaths register ki, yaani qareeb 16 roz [[ncrb-cii-2024]].

Yeh presumption isliye maayne rakhta hai kyunki sasural ke andar hui maut ka shaayad koi bahar ka gawah na ho, aur jo jaante hain ki kya hua, woh khud accused ho sakte hain. Par yeh poori family ko doshi nahi banata. Yeh usi insaan par lagta hai jiske baare mein dikhaya jaye ki usne use harass kiya. Isiliye woh record jo ek aurat jeete-ji chhodti hai, ki kisne kya maanga aur kisne kya kiya, case ka faisla kar sakta hai. Agar yeh padhkar aapke ya aapke kisi jaanne wale ke man mein suicide ka khayal aa raha hai, toh Tele-MANAS ko 14416 par call kijiye [[tele-manas]].

## Bahu aur uske maa-baap kya kar sakte hain

Har insaan aur har harkat ka naam lijiye. "Mere sasural wale mujhe pareshan karte hain" kamzor complaint hai. "3 March ko meri saas ne mera salary card le liya; 10 March ko jab maine wapas maanga toh mere devar ne mujhe maara" aisi complaint hai jiski police investigation kar sakti hai. Jis complaint mein poori family par sirf general ilzaam hon, uski investigation mushkil hoti hai aur use challenge karna aasaan. Saaf-saaf likhna case ko mazboot banata hai, aur un relatives ke saath bhi insaaf hai jinhone kuch nahi kiya.

Police ke steps jaaniye.
